Hey all,

Long story short I used to have a drill that lived in my house. It now lives somewhere else.

I have a pretty hefty amount of money in Lowes gift cards and thought, "I really should get a drill."

So I wanted to see what everyone's thoughts were on the best drill for the buck that you can get from Lowes.
Best Drill For Cost at Lowes

Need more limits of requirements.

  • Corded or Cordless? Does it matter?
  • If cordless, do you want the batteries to be able to power other tools? (Leaf blower, trimmer, circular saw, flashlights, reciprocating saw, etc) ?
  • Type of work to be performed. Is it for just doing small jobs around the house, or for serious projects?
  • Tend to work more with wood, or metal? (Anything will work on plastic or plaster)

These are important questions for a number of reasons, one of them being your request for "Best Drill for COST". There are good brands available at Lowe's, but do you want to have a heavy toque, high-speed drill motor that needs to be rebuilt for $100, or a cheap drill that does most everything but is disposable because you can replace the whole thing for $100 ?

I guess the most important question is if you plan to use it for consistent projects, or just around the house when you need it. Cordless sets are nice because a lot of the time you can use the batteries to power other tools. Unfortunately, Lowe's has a poor selection for mid-range power tools that use common batteries across many other tools. Your best bet for the dollar's will most likely be Black and Decker, which is the home-owners line made from the same company that makes DeWalt tools.
